entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. A VeloBand GPS Tracker.
Okay, I can look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. The order is VF88602.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 14th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. It's fine.
I understand. Sometimes a product just doesn't meet expectations. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Whatever. Just tell me if you can take it back.
One moment... Okay, I've checked our system. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. So yes, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Really? I figured it would be a whole thing.

Not at all. Since you're within the timeframe, it's a straightforward process. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You just need to print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Fine. I guess that's one less hassle.
Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
